persons.name: Ṭoḍarānanda
persons.evidence: vilikhatya śūbhamaṃ vedvāś dhanāyaṃ suviñair anativipulavudhir ṭōḍarānandasaṃjñaḥ

date.as_written: śaradi apani paṃcāṅkendge īṣa śūbhre ahi tithi gurū pāre

notes: Īṣa (Iṣa) refers to the month of Āśvina; śubhra refers to śuklapakṣa; ahi tithi likely refers to the 8th tithi. The chronogram for the year includes avani (1), pañca (5), aṅka (9), indu (1), possibly VS 1951 or VS 1591.
